caption: 1 · Three identities, each a palette, a UI face and a scripture face; the marks palette is the same in all three
2 · Each identity in dark; the page surface's colors are a theme the person can change (row 3)
4 · Scripture faces side by side at reading size (all free and open licensed); Crimson Pro is the fifth, drawn on request
5 · Reading: no rail, no chrome but a quiet top line; the dock waits at the bottom edge
6 · The dock up: home, the apps, Settings; open apps carry a dot; the name shows on hover
9 · Static taskbar (Settings › Dock › Always shown): the same apps, always visible, the reader stops above it
11 · The Workbench home: where you left off, today's reading, open questions, recent pages; one click resumes each
13 · Together A, Snap: drag an app's title to the top edge for layouts (halves, two-thirds, thirds, quarters); like Windows snap layouts
14 · Together B, Stage: the working set in the middle; other sets wait at the left as small cards, one click swaps them in (like Stage Manager)
15 · Together C, Desks: a named, saved arrangement of apps per task; switching desks swaps the whole screen; nothing stays open unseen
